## Summary

A short description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Problem It Solves

What problem does this feature solve? Who benefits from it?

## Proposed Solution

Describe how you imagine the feature working. If you have a specific implementation idea, share it here.

## Alternatives Considered

Have you considered any alternative approaches? Why is your proposed solution better?

## Additional Context

Any mockups, screenshots, links, or references that might help clarify the feature.

## Contribution

- [ ] I'd be willing to implement this feature myself
